sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-MP21 key (RB-MP21) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the Federal State Reserve Agency base Service and Repair Center workshop rooms.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Interchange
sections.text: - In Grumpy's hideout inside the power station, in the shelf directly left after entering

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Second floor of the Western Repair Point Building (black knight) on Reserve. (Highlighted in green)

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Two Drawers
- One Weapon rack (AK-74N, AKS-74U, AKS-74N, AKS-74UB, AKS-74UN)
- One AKS-74N spawn
- Loose loot (Weapon mods, Ammunition)
- One Toolbox
- One Weapon Box (4x4)
- Intelligence folder spawn on desk & on cabinets.
- 6-STEN-140-M military battery spawn (On the table to the right of the door.)
